selected_entries.use: Prior evidence and acceptance criteria for source-derived focus scenes, directed labeled portals, keyboard parity, persistent relation state, and non-color cues.
Prior timing boundary: keep OEW work candidate-local and do not infer ontology correctness, promotion, or production authority from a UI prototype.
Reuse only current ownership, adapter, and browser-harness lessons; its historical runtime-status conclusions are superseded and must be reverified.

excluded_or_limited_entries.reason: Coverage is incomplete and its validation state is flag.
Proposal artifacts are not implementation or user-comprehension evidence.

live_source_observations.observation: The current graph returns the complete filtered graph when neither tour nor focus is active.
live_source_observations.research_consequence: The default/home projection must be decided explicitly; focus behavior alone cannot remove the initial black-box view.

live_source_observations.observation: The accepted focus slice demonstrates 4 nodes, 0 internal edges, and 6 labeled portals while the baseline has 237 nodes and 231 edges.
live_source_observations.research_consequence: Progressive disclosure has an executable witness, but human comprehension remains pending.

live_source_observations.observation: The local prototype gateway can synthesize staleness status as unknown with graph-commit-unavailable.
live_source_observations.research_consequence: Removing the banner outright may erase a real provenance boundary; compare truthful prototype-specific replacements and a valid freshness source.

live_source_observations.observation: The UI already derives edge styling from edge type, while full edge text is expanded only in an active focus scene.
live_source_observations.research_consequence: Compare relation-type color and redundant encodings before inventing a unique color per individual edge.

unresolved_gaps: No current evidence-backed map explains every visible top-level button, its state effect, and whether it belongs in the Body War learning view.
No accepted decision defines the initial/home projection after launch or what action intentionally opens the complete graph.
No ontology-backed icon taxonomy maps business category, node kind, authority state, or candidate status onto cards.
No accepted visual grammar maps relation type, source predicate, direction, label, line style, marker, and color without semantic collapse.
The correct handling of graph freshness in a candidate-local prototype is unresolved.
Human novice comprehension, keyboard comprehension, forced-colors behavior, and reduced-motion behavior have not been measured for the new focus scene.
External primary evidence for graph progressive disclosure, icon semantics, and edge-label readability has not yet been collected.
dispatch_consequences: Use three independent explorer lanes: current-source/runtime mechanics, ontology semantics, and UX/accessibility precedent.
Require exact source selectors, current browser observations, and primary external sources for every load-bearing recommendation.
Force a decision matrix for freshness, controls, initial scene, card iconography, edge labels, edge encoding, legend, and tests.
Treat unique-per-edge color as a user hypothesis, not a requirement; compare relation-type palettes with text, direction, markers, and line patterns.
Do not authorize product mutation, ontology promotion, public release, or claims of user comprehension.
Defer Inventory attachment after the run if the current unrelated Inventory worktree overlap remains.
